title: Symmetry-Breaking and Hysteresis in a Duplex Voter Model
summary: We introduce and analyze a voter-type model on a two-layer multiplex network, where the presence of a state on one layer acts as a catalyst or inhibitor to the propagation of that state on the other layer. Despite the model's simplicity, our mathematical analysis reveals a rich phase diagram that includes spontaneous symmetry-breaking and a cusp bifurcation, which arises when noise is introduced into the model.
